2  Cond  size:8    condition negated  if big n → if not (big n)
3  Cond  both:12   condition negated  if a && b → if not (a && b)
4  Cond  both:12   operator flipped   a && b → a || b
5  Cond  small:16  operator flipped   n < 3 → n <= 3
6  Cond  fixed:20  bool flipped       True → False

-  Cond  fixed:20  condition negated  equivalent: a literal condition
